neighbours.label: ' all' (and the following this/that/those) in the emphatic mass sense 'all the / all this / all those X' (what with all the…, what's all this…, tired of all those…), not the universal quantifier
fire: Nobody could concentrate, what with all the shouting in the corridor.
Honestly, what's all this nonsense about cancelling the trip?
He had grown tired of all those emails asking for favours.
But what about all those families who lost their homes?
She finally fell asleep, worn out from all that travelling.
I wonder what all the excitement is about down at the harbour.
With all this rain lately, the garden has turned into a swamp.
Where does all that money go at the end of the year?
quiet: The survey was carried out in all provinces of the country.
Every member of the club must pay the fee by March.
The team scored at least twice in every match this season.
All passengers should remain seated until the bus stops.
The virus has been reported in every county except one.
Such stories are told in all cultures and in every age.
They won all but two of their games last year.
Each of the children received a small gift at the door.

notes: Card: ' all' x14 plus those/this/that; the - pole is the universal quantifier (every state, in all cultures). Probe: 'what is all this fuss' 1.00, 'what with all the noise' 0.68; 'in all regions' 0.01, 'All students' 0.01, 'ate all the cookies' 0.09.
